In this role, you will set the standards for how process safety is managed across our projects and future assets, from design and construction through commissioning and operations. Ensure compliance with SEVESO III requirements and support the Major Accident Prevention Policy, Safety Reports, regulatory inspections and audits. Govern key process safety activities, including HAZOP, LOPA, QRA and Management of Change (MOC). Develop and monitor process safety KPIs and barrier management to strengthen risk control and performance. Lead process safety audits, incident learning and improvement initiatives across projects and assets. Build process safety capability across the organization through training, guidance and functional leadership for Engineering, Projects, Operations, Maintenance and contractors. You are someone who feels comfortable in an entrepreneurial environment, takes ownership, and thrives when things are still developing. You combine deep technical expertise with the ability to turn complex regulatory and risk-management requirements into practical standards. jobs.description: À propos d'Everfield Everfield achète, développe et accompagne la croissance d'éditeurs de logiciels métiers et spécialisés en Europe, en leur donnant les clés pour franchir un cap. Notre mission : nourrir l'ambition, alimenter la croissance et révéler le potentiel de l'écosystème logiciel européen. jobs.title: Onderzoeksstage Water en Ruimte
jobs.description: 24-40 uur per week | Utrecht | Hybride | € 600,- stagevergoeding | Wo-bachelor/-master Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot Waterbeheer heeft wonen, werken en leven in Nederland mogelijk gemaakt. Dat systeem is over honderden jaren opgebouwd en ingericht op een gematigd klimaat. Met zeespiegelstijging, droogte en zware neerslag lopen we nu tegen de grenzen aan. Drinkwaterbedrijven luiden de noodklok over leveringszekerheid en piekbuien wisselen af met extreme droogte. Water is bepalend voor waar we kunnen bouwen, werken en leven. Om weerbaar te worden moeten we andere keuzes maken over de inrichting en het gebruik van onze leefomgeving, waarbij functies beter aansluiten op de draagkracht van het water- en bodemsysteem. Elke dag worden er nieuwe ruimtelijke keuzes gemaakt, bijvoorbeeld over woningbouw, bedrijfsuitbreiding of het energiesysteem. Om daarin meer rekening te houden met water en bodem moeten de wereld van water en bodem en de wereld van ruimtelijke ordening beter samenwerken en elkaars taal leren spreken. Daarvoor bestaan al instrumenten, methoden en werkwijzen, zoals Omgevingstafels, de Watertoets, blauwe omgevingsvisies en water- en bodemsysteemanalyses. Maar werken die instrumenten ook echt, en wat is er nodig om ze beter te laten aansluiten op de praktijk? Dat zoeken wij uit. jobs.title: CENTRALE LYON - Post Doctoral Open and Flexible System-Level Evaluation Framework for Emerging AI Computing Architectures
tags: inl - institut des nanotechnologies de lyon
jobs.description: Emerging computing technologies – non-volatile and ferroelectric memories, analog and digital in-memory computing, silicon photonics, 3D integration, and heterogeneous chiplets – offer major gains in energy efficiency, latency, bandwidth, and functionality. Their potential cannot, however, be established from device or circuit results alone: it requires a rigorous link between technology characteristics, architectural choices, workload mapping, and application-level figures of merit. The Electronics group at the Lyon Institute of Nanotechnology (INL) is seeking a (m/f) postdoctoral researcher to develop an open, modular and extensible system-level evaluation framework for design space exploration (DSE) and system-design-technology co-optimization (SDTCO) of emerging computing architectures. The focus is at the interface of computer architecture, accelerator design, performance modelling and hardware-software codesign, while making systematic use of lower-level device, circuit and array results so that architectural conclusions remain physically credible. The objective is to convert low-level results – compact models, measured or simulated KPIs, variability and reliability constraints, and multi-objective Pareto fronts – into parameterized architectural models supporting efficient exploration of accelerators for emerging AI workloads. The framework must enable both bottom-up projection, from device/circuit/array choices toward system performance, and top-down constraint propagation, from targets for energy, latency, throughput, accuracy, robustness and area toward technology and circuit requirements. It will consolidate ongoing INL activities in predictive system assessment, DTCO, emerging memories, compute-in-memory and photonic computing, integrating or extending existing components with emphasis on openness, reproducibility and reusability. jobs.title: (Senior) Deployment Strategist
jobs.description: You take a signed customer and turn them into a flagship reference, owning the journey from first go-live to a full rollout across their plants. Ethon was built to eliminate the trillion-dollar waste problem in manufacturing. We are the technology leader in Industrial AI, building agentic workflows that help manufacturers optimize cost, quality, and speed of production. We serve manufacturers from Siemens and Bosch to Lindt and Roche, and are backed by Index Ventures, General Catalyst, and Earlybird. Our team draws from Palantir, McKinsey, Meta, Google, and top manufacturing companies, all here for the same reason: giving manufacturers the technology to run every factory at unprecedented productivity. WHAT IS THIS JOB ABOUT? You will take a signed logo and turn them into a flagship reference. That means getting onto the shopfloor fast, understanding what drives their KPIs, and deploying Ethon's agentic workflows where the impact is highest. You implement the first use case while already mapping the next. Once one is live, you find the next one. When the engineer is sold, you bring in the plant manager. Once the plant manager is convinced, you get to the COO. jobs.title: Senior Applied Scientist
jobs.description: Meet the team You’ll join the Traffic Control Features team within TomTom’s Automated Driving organization . The team builds the technology that turns real-world observations into reliable map information about traffic signs, traffic lights, stop lines and road markings . You’ll work with applied scientists and software engineers to develop algorithms and machine-learning solutions that detect, position and connect these features to the right roads and driving directions. The goal is to deliver accurate, scalable map content that supports navigation and advanced driving experiences. TomTom measures these features using quality dimensions such as recall, precision, and road-relation accuracy. What you will do: Develop algorithms and ML solutions for traffic signs, traffic lights, road markings, and other traffic-control features, including projects with Computer Vision and Image Recognition. Design and productionize solutions that extract reliable map information from diverse, large-scale and noisy real-world data sources, including car sensor data and unstructured information. Improve how features are detected, positioned, and associated with the correct road/lane and driving direction. Drive measurable improvements in recall, precision, and overall map quality against customer-facing targets. Own components of production pipelines, from input data and feature extraction through evaluation and validated map output. Solve complex problems involving geospatial geometry, map matching, computer vision, image recognition, noisy observations, ground-truth quality, and large-scale evaluation. Run experiments, translate successful approaches into production solutions, and clearly document outcomes. Use AI tools, such as Claude Code, to support problem solving, data analysis, implementation, and engineering productivity. Mentor junior colleagues, provide insightful code reviews, and contribute to hiring. What you will need: 4+ years of professional experience in Applied Scie

Als Manager Customer Data Engineering ontwikkel je een ervaren engineeringteam door naar een strategisch Data Product Team. jobs.description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: Samsara’s Installation Engineers are on the front lines of ensuring customers successfully deploy our hardware and technology at scale. In this role, you will oversee customer engagements with installation partners, provide onsite support for complex deployments, and proactively de-risk projects to deliver smooth, high-quality installations. You’ll work closely with customers, partners, and cross-functional teams to ensure every project drives adoption and long-term value. This role is ideal for someone with experience in project management, installation oversight, or field services who thrives in fast-paced, customer-facing environments. High level of travel is expected with potential overnight stays. jobs.title: 3D & LiDAR Data Annotation Analyst
jobs.description: About the Role We’re building high-quality ground-truth datasets used to train and validate perception models for autonomous and operator-assisted machines working in complex, real-world environments. As a Data Annotation Analyst, you’ll work with camera imagery, video, and LiDAR point clouds to create precise labels that help perception systems understand objects, people, terrain, and surrounding environments. You’ll work in specialized annotation tools, following detailed specifications while balancing accuracy, consistency, and production volume. Your Impact Annotate 2D and 3D objects across images, video, and LiDAR point clouds, including vehicles, machinery, people, signage, and environmental features. Create and maintain accurate segmentation, object tracking, pose, and keypoint annotations across sequences. Apply detailed annotation guidelines, including class definitions, occlusion rules, object thresholds, and inclusion/exclusion criteria. Review your work, respond to QA feedback, and maintain established quality and accuracy standards. Identify and escalate ambiguous scenes, sensor artifacts, tooling issues, and gaps in specifications rather than making assumptions. Document data quality and tooling issues with clear details and reproduction steps. Participate in calibration sessions, guideline reviews, and team standups to maintain consistent interpretations. Share observations that help improve annotation guidelines, taxonomies, and edge-case documentation. Success in this role means producing accurate, consistent annotations at the expected volume while helping maintain a reliable, high-quality dataset. What You Bring Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accuracy while performing repetitive, visually intensive work for extended periods. Strong spatial reasoning skills, including the ability to interpret 3D environments and understand object size, position, and orientation. jobs.description: Da oltre 25 anni offriamo sui mercati globali cosmetici Made in Italy . Progettiamo, sviluppiamo, produciamo e confezioniamo in-house . Per la sede di Lugano siamo alla ricerca di un/a IT Applications & AI Specialist che contribuisca allo sviluppo e all’evoluzione dell’ecosistema digitale aziendale, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni Microsoft 365, alle applicazioni interne, all’automazione dei processi e ai progetti di Intelligenza Artificiale . Lowongan Kerja PT Indocement Tunggal Prakarsa Tbk. PT Indocement Tunggal Prakarsa Tbk. telah memiliki sejarah yang sangat panjang di industri semen nasional. Cikal bakal pendirian Perseroan telah dimulai sejak 1975 dengan berdirinya PT Distinct Indonesia Cement Enterprise (DICE) yang memiliki pabrik semen dengan kapasitas terpasang sebesar 500.000 ton di wilayah Citeureup, Jawa Barat. Pada Oktober 2016, Perseroan mulai mengoperasikan pabrik ketiga belas yang disebut Plant 14 di Kompleks Pabrik Citeureup. Pabrik dengan kapasitas produksi 4,4 juta ton per tahun ini merupakan pabrik semen terintegrasi terbesar yang pernah dibangun oleh Indocement dan HeidelbergCement Group. Dengan beroperasinya Plant 14, kapasitas terpasang Perseroan meningkat menjadi 25,5 juta ton semen/tahun. jobs.title: Rekrutmen Bina BNI Kantor Wilayah 09
jobs.description: PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (BNI) Adalah Bank BUMN (Badan Usaha Milik Negara) pertama yang menjadi perusahaan publik setelah mencatatkan sahamnya di Bursa Efek Jakarta dan Bursa Efek Surabaya pada tahun 1996. Berikut ini adalah Rekrutmen Bina BNI Kantor Wilayah 17. P T Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero), Tbk pada awalnya didirikan di Indonesia sebagai Bank sentral dengan nama “Bank Negara Indonesia” berdasarkan Peraturan Pemerintah Pengganti Undang-Undang No. 2 tahun 1946 tanggal 5 Juli 1946. Selanjutnya, berdasarkan Undang-Undang No. 17 tahun 1968, BNI ditetapkan menjadi “Bank Negara Indonesia 1946”, dan statusnya menjadi Bank Umum Milik Negara. Selanjutnya, peran BNI sebagai Bank yang diberi mandat untuk memperbaiki ekonomi rakyat dan berpartisipasi dalam pembangunan nasional dikukuhkan oleh UU No. 17 tahun 1968 tentang Bank Negara Indonesia 1946. Berdasarkan Peraturan Pemerintah No. 19 tahun 1992, tanggal 29 April 1992, telah dilakukan penyesuaian bentuk hukum BNI menjadi Perusahaan Perseroan Terbatas (Persero). Penyesuaian bentuk hukum menjadi Persero, dinyatakan dalam Akta No. 131, tanggal 31 Juli 1992, dibuat di hadapan Muhani Salim, S.H., yang telah diumumkan dalam Berita Negara Republik Indonesia No. 73 tanggal 11 September 1992 Tambahan No. 1A. Lowongan Kerja PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) Tbk Saat ini Bank BNI memberikan kesempatan lowongan kerja untuk dapat bergabung bersama dengan posisi sebagai berikut: Bina BNI Kantor Wilayah 09 Job Description: BINA BNI adalah salah satu program BNI untuk membangun bangsa. Program ini merupakan bagian dari pelatihan dan bimbingan kerja kepada angkatan kerja yang belum berpengalaman dengan memberikan pengetahuan, keterampilan, dan kemampuan (Knowledge, Skill, Ability) yang diselenggarakan secara terpadu antara pelatihan berbasis teori dan praktik secara langsung. Minimum Qualifications: Warga Negara Indonesia Fresh graduate, belum pernah memiliki pengalaman bekerja Pendidikan minimal SMA /SMK dengan rata-ra

jobs.title: Rekrutmen PT Pelita Air Service
jobs.description: PT Pelita Air Service (Pelita Air) adalah perusahaan maskapai penerbangan nasional terkemuka di Indonesia yang merupakan anak perusahaan dari badan usaha milik negara (BUMN), PT Pertamina (Persero). Berdiri sejak tahun 1970, perusahaan ini awalnya didirikan untuk mendukung kegiatan operasional industri minyak dan gas bumi Pertamina. Namun, seiring dengan perkembangannya yang pesat, Pelita Air kini telah bertransformasi menjadi salah satu penyedia layanan transportasi udara paling komprehensif di tanah air. Sebagai maskapai penerbangan dengan reputasi tinggi, Pelita Air menjalankan model bisnis yang mencakup beberapa pilar utama. Perusahaan ini menyediakan layanan penerbangan komersial berjadwal (scheduled flights) dengan konsep layanan menengah (medium service) menggunakan armada modern seperti Airbus A320 untuk menghubungkan berbagai kota besar di Indonesia. PERURI juga terus memperkuat bisnis inti sebagai pencetak uang Rupiah, paspor, pita cukai, meterai dan dokumen pertanahan sesuai dengan Peraturan Pemerintah (PP) Nomor 6 Tahun 2019.
